behavior: Through the existing authenticated POST /api/multiplayer/matches door, an explicit co-op mission descriptor creates one durable real combat match with server-derived per-unit owners. Validate the accepted branch/revision/effectiveGeneration, active campaign membership, accepted participation, roster references and each contributor's durable force claim: the initiating host is not required to own the guest's approved force. Ignore client owner/player claims. Both deploying rosters are player-side; admitted OpFor stays opponent-side and ownerless. Distinct coopMission metadata carries campaignId, sessionId, missionId, acceptedHead and requestFingerprint so creation/recovery cannot mistake this match for another campaign-sync vessel. Persist immutable mission identity and match metadata together; serialize final expected-head admission through the existing campaign authority boundary and arbitrate duplicate creation durably. An identical stored receipt returns the original missionMatchId without another create/append, even when a later head has advanced; a divergent identity or stale new request refuses typed and never closes a previously successful match. Start and recover through the existing combat host registry. Refuse missing claims/choices, forged or inconsistent refs and nonmembers with zero new match side effects. Red-first actual route/auth/SQLite/host tests cover valid two-contributor creation, concurrent/identical/divergent retry and cold reopen; HTTP surface proof records status/headers/body and before/after match/receipt counts. Preserve existing vessel, versus and single-player behavior. No announcement, page navigation, AI driving or U38 command refusal is claimed here. Admission re-measures the proposed ten-file/430-product-line estimate against the unchanged 15/500 caps.
